steadyModelSlope.note: audit CR2 with t(G-1); author primary = released cluster protocol t(G-1); ends differ by <= 0.01 vs the like-for-like interval

finding: The audit found a defect in the author's Theil-Sen bootstrap: pairs with dx<0 on resampled (unsorted) days were dropped, halving the pair set and widening the E1/E3/E4 intervals. Fixed in tools/steady_load_spread.py (every unordered pair with dx != 0 counts once) and covered by a new known-answer test against scipy.stats.theilslopes; E1 day interval now equals the audit's to 4 decimals. The grade is unchanged (it uses the model slopes and the paired difference).
